title: The Watchtower Without a Door
rumor: The Watchtower Without a Door. A solitary stone tower stands upon a remote ridge, built in a style unlike any current Cadorian fortification. Its walls are smooth and unbroken, with no visible entrance at ground level. At sunset, a red light occasionally appears within the highest window, despite the tower having been abandoned for centuries.
first_lead: The tower can reportedly be seen from a particular bend in an old mountain road.
